properties.description: store_exists(graph_path) and may_open(graph_path, read_only): a store exists at the path or it does not, and --read-only opens only one that exists, because opening a missing store creates it. Asked of the path alone, before anything is opened. Asked by the one-shot door (one_shot::resolve_design), the --shared client, the latent surface's promotion, every serving mode in main (stdio, --http, --serve-shared serve the latent surface where they may not open) and the registry's discovery. A unit test scans src/ so no other code tests a graph path for a store itself.
properties.name: opening.rs — "may this open create a store?", one rule for every mode
